author: Assistant session at the owner's request (Issue #25 decision of 2026-11-19); owner acceptance pending through the review of PR #24
reason: Issue #25 (owner decision, 2026-11-19): the checkpoint download is a streaming Internet -> ext4 transfer of file pages, independent of the RAM/paging limits that protect inference, oracle and benchmark runs. Amendments 001 (hostgate10 GO required by acquire10 --execute) and 002 (in-run host monitor stopping the transfer) imposed inference-run criteria on a file transfer.

Observed incident: the authorized real download was stopped by HostPressureStop: host_available_bytes=267665408 violates >= 300000000, with no checksum, space or HTTP error. The download was later completed with a local, temporary disabling of the gate (report acquisition-resume-20261119T183903Z.json, outside the repository); this amendment makes the correction permanent and versioned.

acquire10 now requires only the owner authorization; it never consults hostgate10 and never stops for host or guest memory pressure. It stops only for acquisition risks. Manifest pinning, metadata verification, SHA256/LFS and Git blob checks, strict Range/Content-Range/Content-Length, resume of owned .part files, no overwrite, lock, space guard and ENOSPC handling are unchanged. Optional host diagnostics (--host-diagnostics) record hostmonitor10 samples without ever stopping the transfer.

hostmem10, hostgate10 and hostmonitor10 are kept unchanged for inference, oracle and benchmark runs. Amendments 001 and 002 are historical and stay in the chain unchanged; their sections remain readable but no longer bind the acquisition.

Tests: no node ID removed or renamed (inventory superset). The bodies of the acquire10 integration tests in test_increment10_hostgate.py and test_increment10_hostmonitor.py now assert the amended policy (gate verdicts still computed; the acquisition completes whatever they are). New tests prove that a synthetic critical host never stops a correct transfer, that resume is unaffected, and that the acquisition path imports no host gate.

invariants.note: host start/abort criteria keep their frozen values for runtime and oracle profiles; the download profile is no longer applied by the acquisition

acquisition_host_policy.rule: acquire10 --execute requires the owner authorization only; it never requires a host GO (hostgate10) and never stops for host AvailableBytes, commit, pagefile, paging, guest MemAvailable or swap
supersedes: 001: hostgate10 GO required by acquire10 --execute (before network and before payload)
002: in-run host monitor mapping pause/kill/stop actions to a stop of the transfer
acquisition_host_policy.diagnostics: optional and non-blocking: acquire10 --host-diagnostics BASELINE records hostmonitor10 samples and the decisions amendment 002 would have applied (reasons_ignored)

not_verifiable_on_runner.skip_message: local unsanitized originals are not on this machine
not_verifiable_on_runner.cause: tests/test_increment9_hardening.py "-real" cases need the local unsanitized M9 originals, which are deliberately not in Git (sanitization of increment 9)

ci_runner_verification.rule: runner verdict PASS = every runner-verifiable required test passed, nothing missing, extra or duplicated, and each declared test either passed or was skipped with exactly the declared message; such a skip is NOT VERIFIABLE ON RUNNER and keeps the full-inventory verdict of the runner at NOT PROVEN. The archived local attestation must be a full PASS of the same inventory with its pinned JUnit SHA256. CI succeeds only if both hold.
